Data associated with the publication "A century of shifting native species-accumulation curves reveals long-term biodiversity loss". Abstract: The species-area relationship is a cornerstone of biodiversity theory and conservation. Yet, its temporal stability remains largely untested. Using nearly a century of disjunct vegetation-plot data from the Netherlands, we assess changes in the species-area relationship by constructing species-accumulation curves (SACs).
